voiceDesign.previewText: 师傅，请问去三里屯怎么走？这桥叫什么桥来着？

voiceDesign.previewText: 会不会开车啊！这路堵的，到地方得天黑。

mm.style: 四十来岁的北京爷们儿，京腔，说话直来直去。
mm.styleEn: A Beijing man in his forties, blunt and down to earth.

mo.style: 七十岁左右的北京老大爷，京腔儿化音重，说话慢悠悠。
mo.styleEn: An old Beijing man around seventy, speaking slowly and leisurely.

voiceDesign.previewText: 来来来，往这边看，笑一个！我的天，北京真大！

fy.style: 二十多岁的年轻姑娘，普通话，说话自然、口语化。
fy.styleEn: A young woman in her twenties, talking naturally and casually.

fm.name: 中年女

voiceDesign.prompt: 中年女性，40 岁左右，北京口音，中音，音色明亮温和，语速中等，说话爽快利落、有亲和力。
voiceDesign.previewText: 来啦？今儿吃点儿什么？这雨下的，出门忘带伞了。

fm.style: 四十来岁的北京大姐，京腔，说话爽快。
fm.styleEn: A Beijing woman in her forties, brisk and straightforward.

fo.name: 老年女

voiceDesign.prompt: 中老年女性，55 岁左右，北京口音，嗓门大、音调偏高，声音洪亮略尖，语速快，热情爱咋呼，说话一惊一乍。
voiceDesign.previewText: 哟，遛弯儿呢？一会儿跳完舞，去买俩西红柿。

fo.style: 六十多岁的北京大妈，嗓门大，说话热络。
fo.styleEn: A Beijing auntie in her sixties, loud and friendly.

xm.name: 外国游客

voiceDesign.prompt: 青年男性，25 岁左右，母语是英语的外国人，说中文发音生硬、声调不准，带明显的美式英语口音，语气热情友好、充满好奇。
voiceDesign.previewText: Excuse me，请问，您能带我去天安门吗？Thank you so much！

xm.style: 来北京旅游的外国小伙子，中文不太流利，带明显的外国口音，英文部分是美式英语。
xm.styleEn: A young American tourist in Beijing, speaking his native American English, friendly and curious.

laok.name: 老K

voiceDesign.prompt: 老年男性，60 岁左右，北京口音，音色低沉沙哑、有磁性，语速缓慢，说话沉稳，带江湖气。
voiceDesign.previewText: 小子，来了？坐。这北京城啊，钱都在路上跑。

laok.style: 老K，六十岁上下的北京老江湖，做中间人生意，京腔，说话慢条斯理、不怒自威。
laok.styleEn: Old K, a Beijing fixer around sixty, unhurried, quietly menacing.

xiaoyu.name: 小雨

voiceDesign.prompt: 青年女性，22 岁左右，音色清亮偏甜，语速偏快，说话机灵俏皮，标准普通话。
voiceDesign.previewText: 哟，你怎么来了？我这正刷机呢，等会儿。

xiaoyu.style: 小雨，二十出头的技术宅姑娘，说话快、机灵、带点儿调皮。
xiaoyu.styleEn: Xiaoyu, a techie girl in her early twenties, quick, clever and a little cheeky.

daliu.name: 大刘

voiceDesign.prompt: 中年男性，45 岁左右，北京口音，音色浑厚略粗，嗓门大，说话憨厚爽朗，语速中等。
voiceDesign.previewText: 来啦！车怎么样？齐活儿！车给你弄好了。

daliu.style: 大刘，四十多岁的修车师傅、老司机，京腔，憨厚爽快，爱吹当年。
daliu.styleEn: Big Liu, a mechanic and veteran driver in his forties, hearty and plain-spoken, loves to brag about the old days.

wang.name: 王队

voiceDesign.prompt: 中年男性，50 岁左右，音色低沉有力，吐字清晰，语速偏慢，严肃威严，带命令口吻。
voiceDesign.previewText: 又是你。别给我惹事儿。我盯着你呢，好好开车。

wang.style: 王队，五十岁的老刑警队长，声音沉稳威严，说话简短，略带警告。
wang.styleEn: Captain Wang, a veteran police captain of fifty, calm, stern, few words, a hint of warning.

laozhang.name: 老张

voiceDesign.prompt: 老年男性，70 岁左右，北京口音很重，儿化音多，音色温和略沙哑，语速缓慢，和蔼爱唠叨。
voiceDesign.previewText: 小伙子，跑出租啦？开出租就两条：嘴要甜，车要稳。

laozhang.style: 老张，七十岁的老出租车司机，京腔儿化音重，慢悠悠，和蔼爱唠叨。
laozhang.styleEn: Old Zhang, a cab driver of seventy, slow, kindly and chatty.

liujie.name: 刘姐

voiceDesign.prompt: 中年女性，45 岁左右，北京口音，嗓门亮，音色明快，语速偏快，热情麻利。
voiceDesign.previewText: 来啦？今儿吃点儿什么？加个蛋不？薄脆给你多放点儿。

liujie.style: 刘姐，四十多岁摆煎饼摊的大姐，京腔，热情麻利。
liujie.styleEn: Sister Liu, a jianbing stall owner in her forties, warm and brisk.

chenye.name: 陈野

voiceDesign.prompt: 青年男性，28 岁左右，音色低沉偏冷、略带沙哑，语速偏慢，话少、冷静，语气淡淡的带点儿嘲讽，普通话略带北京口音。
voiceDesign.previewText: 街没变，人变了。你们找错人了，我只管开车。

chenye.style: 陈野，二十八岁的前地下车手，主角，话少、嘴毒、沉着，北京口音不重。
chenye.styleEn: Chen Ye, a former street racer of twenty-eight, the hero: few words, dry and sharp, unflappable.

baoge.name: 豹哥

voiceDesign.prompt: 中年男性，45 岁左右，北京口音，音色低沉粗哑、有压迫感，语速偏慢，说话阴沉带笑，透着狠劲儿。
voiceDesign.previewText: 身手不错啊。回去告诉老K，东郊这片儿，姓豹。

baoge.style: 豹哥，四十多岁的东郊黑帮头目，黑豹帮老大，京腔，阴沉狠辣，说话慢、带笑也带威胁。
baoge.styleEn: Panther, the East Side gang boss in his forties: slow, smiling and menacing.

laozhou.name: 老周

voiceDesign.prompt: 中年男性，55 岁左右，北京口音，音色偏亮略尖，语速中等偏快，说话带官腔、圆滑，透着心虚。
voiceDesign.previewText: 这车停这儿不行啊。罚款二百，扣三分——你自己说，怎么办？

laozhou.style: 老周，五十多岁的交警，管拖车场，官腔，圆滑又心虚，急了就慌。
laozhou.styleEn: Zhou, a traffic cop in his fifties who runs the tow yard: officious and slippery, panicky when cornered.

feilong.name: 小飞龙

voiceDesign.prompt: 青年男性，19 岁左右，音色清亮偏高，语速很快，语气嚣张、爱挑衅，带点儿痞气。
voiceDesign.previewText: 哟，开出租的也敢来找我？三环上我叫小飞龙。

feilong.style: 小飞龙，十九岁的飙车小子，嚣张、语速快、爱挑衅。
feilong.styleEn: Little Dragon, a nineteen-year-old street racer, cocky, fast-talking and provocative.

lines.textEn: The street hasn't changed. The people have.

lines.instruct: 小声嘀咕，无奈又早有预料。
lines.textEn: I knew it wouldn't be that simple.

lines.text: 三年了。还认得这条街吗？
lines.instruct: 慢悠悠地开口，像在试探，带一点儿感慨。
lines.textEn: Three years. You still know this street?
lines.instructEn: Slow and probing, a little wistful.

lines.text: 你那笔医药费，我不催。帮我跑一趟，算你还一半。
lines.instruct: 不紧不慢，给人情也给压力。
lines.textEn: Your hospital bill - I won't push. Do one run for me and we'll call it half paid.
lines.instructEn: Unhurried, a favour with pressure behind it.

lines.text: 小雨在国贸等你，有个包要送到我车库。别问里面是什么。
lines.instruct: 压低声音交代，最后一句加重语气。
lines.textEn: Xiaoyu's waiting at Guomao with a bag for my garage. Don't ask what's in it.
lines.instructEn: Low voice, giving instructions, the last sentence firm.

lines.text: 东郊那帮人最近不老实。车停在路边，钥匙在上面。
lines.instruct: 提醒，带着警告的意味，然后轻描淡写。
lines.textEn: The East Side crew's been restless lately. Car's at the kerb, keys are in it.

lines.text: 车还顺手吧？那是我的宝贝，别给我刮了。
lines.instruct: 电话里，半开玩笑地叮嘱，心疼自己的车。
lines.textEn: Handles all right? That's my baby - don't you scratch it.
lines.instructEn: On the phone, half joking, protective of his car.

lines.text: 听说路上热闹了？豹哥的人敢动我的货……明天来喝茶，有正事。
lines.instruct: 慢条斯理，听得出压着火，最后一句意味深长。
lines.textEn: Heard it got lively out there. Panther's men touching my goods... Come for tea tomorrow. There's real work.
lines.instructEn: Measured, anger held in check, the last line pointed.

lines.text: 你就是陈野？老K说你开车很野。
lines.instruct: 上下打量，好奇又带点儿挑衅。
lines.textEn: So you are Chen Ye. K says you drive wild.
lines.instructEn: Sizing him up, curious and a little provocative.

lines.text: 但愿没有。走吧，回老K那儿，包他要亲手收。
lines.instruct: 撇撇嘴，然后干脆地说正事。
lines.textEn: Let's hope not. Back to K's - he wants the bag in his own hands.
lines.instructEn: A dry pout, then straight to business.

lines.text: 后面那两辆黑车——是黑豹的人！
lines.textEn: Those two black cars behind us - Black Panther!

lines.instructEn: Out of breath, shaken and impressed.

lines.text: K哥，包给你。他这车技，没白长。
lines.instruct: 轻松，有点儿得意，夸人也不好意思明说。
lines.textEn: Your bag, K. And he really can drive.
lines.instructEn: Relaxed, a little smug, praising him without quite saying so.

lines.text: 身手不错啊。老K从哪儿找来的你？
lines.instruct: 阴沉地笑着，慢悠悠地打量。
lines.textEn: Not bad. Where did K dig you up?
lines.instructEn: A dark smile, slowly sizing him up.

lines.text: 拿？你得追得上才行。开车！
lines.textEn: Taking it? You have to catch it first. Go!
lines.instructEn: A sneer, then a sharp shout.

lines.text: 回去告诉老K，东郊这片儿，姓豹。
lines.textEn: Tell K the East Side belongs to Panther.
I'm here for a truck. K's.

lines.text: 开这玩意儿可甩不掉谁。
哟，豹记的车？你小子胆儿够肥的。
lines.textEn: A Panther truck? You've got some nerve, kid.

lines.text: 我瞧瞧……好家伙，全是改装件。还有一本账。
lines.instruct: 边翻边嘀咕，最后一句压低声音，透着吃惊。
lines.textEn: Let's have a look... Tuning parts, the lot. And a ledger.
lines.instructEn: Muttering as he looks, the last sentence hushed and startled.

lines.text: 套牌、黑车、谁给他们供货，全记在上面。
lines.textEn: Fake plates, black cabs, who supplies them - it's all in here.
Here for a wash? We're closed today.

lines.text: 老K？哥几个，给他好好洗洗！
lines.instruct: 先一愣，然后恶狠狠地招呼同伙。
lines.textEn: K? Boys, give him the full wash!
lines.instructEn: Taken aback, then nastily rallying his mates.

lines.text: 里头的，都出来！有人砸场子！
lines.instruct: 扯着嗓子大喊，又惊又怒。
lines.textEn: Get out here! Somebody is wrecking the place!

lines.text: 我一车货，让豹哥的人扣了。就在东四环外头，四惠枢纽边上那家豹记洗车行。
lines.instruct: 压着火，一字一句地交代。
lines.textEn: Panther's men took a whole truckload of mine. It's at their car wash past the East 4th Ring, by the Sihui bus hub.
lines.instructEn: Anger held in, word by word.

lines.text: 三五个看场子的。小雨查过了，货车还没挪窝。
lines.textEn: A few minding the place. Xiaoyu checked - the truck hasn't moved.

lines.text: 把车给我开回来，送到大刘那儿。他会验货。
lines.textEn: Bring it to Big Liu's garage. He'll go through the load.

lines.text: 账本收好。豹哥丢了这个，比丢一车货还疼。
lines.instruct: 电话里，慢条斯理，意味深长。
lines.textEn: Keep that ledger safe. Losing it hurts Panther more than losing the truck.
lines.instructEn: On the phone, measured and pointed.

lines.instruct: 电话里，不慌不忙，带着底气。
lines.instructEn: On the phone, unhurried, sure of himself.

lines.text: 我是小雨。洗车行门口三个，屋里还有，都不是善茬。
lines.instruct: 电话里，语速快，有点儿紧张。
lines.textEn: It's Xiaoyu. Three at the door, more inside. Not the friendly kind.
lines.instructEn: On the phone, fast, a little tense.

lines.text: 货车是辆白色箱货，车厢上印着"豹"字。
lines.instruct: 电话里，干脆利落地补充。
lines.textEn: The truck's a white box van with Panther painted on the side.

lines.text: 货车跑了！它想绕上建国路往城里钻，截住它！
lines.textEn: The truck's running - it wants Jianguo Road into town. Cut it off!
They're dropping back... they've given up!

lines.text: 撞不动……得贴上去，跳过去。
lines.textEn: Doesn't budge... I'll have to get alongside and jump.

lines.text: 账本在副驾上。钱会计，下回记得系安全带。
lines.textEn: Ledger's on the passenger seat. Buckle up next time, Qian.

lines.text: 钱会计记得细。每一笔，后头都有个名字。
lines.textEn: Qian keeps tidy books. Every entry has a name behind it.

lines.text: 你可算来了。昨儿后半夜，豹哥的人把我这铺子砸了。
lines.instruct: 又气又累，拍着大腿抱怨。
lines.textEn: About time. Panther's lot smashed the place up in the small hours.

lines.text: 抢走了。小雨跟了一宿——东西交到了他们管账的手里，钱会计。
lines.textEn: Gone. Xiaoyu tailed them all night - it ended up with their bookkeeper. Qian.
lines.instructEn: A sigh, then a lowered voice.

lines.text: 他那辆奔驰，用的就是你扣下的那批改装件，车门里焊了钢板，撞是撞不动的。
lines.instruct: 认真地提醒，带点儿心疼自己的货。
lines.textEn: His Mercedes is built from the parts you took off them. Steel in the doors. Ramming it won't do a thing.
lines.instructEn: A serious warning, a little sore about his parts.

lines.text: 开我这辆。后备箱里给你装了氮气，追的时候用得上。
lines.instruct: 爽快地递钥匙，带点儿得意。
lines.textEn: Take my car. There's nitro in the boot - you'll want it.
lines.instructEn: Handing over the keys, a bit proud.

lines.textEn: You got it back? Good lad.

lines.text: 这名字……这不是交通队的老周吗？
lines.instruct: 凑过来一看，倒吸一口凉气。
lines.textEn: This name... isn't that Zhou, from the traffic police?
lines.instructEn: Leaning in to look, a sharp intake of breath.

lines.text: 我的车！你知道这是谁的车吗！
lines.instruct: 摔在地上，气急败坏地尖叫。
lines.textEn: My car! Do you know whose car this is?!
lines.instructEn: Sprawled on the road, shrieking with rage.

lines.text: 豹哥上头还有人。账本收好——这回，轮到他们睡不着了。
lines.instruct: 电话里，慢条斯理，意味深长。
lines.textEn: So Panther has someone above him. Keep the ledger safe - this time they're the ones who won't sleep.
lines.instructEn: On the phone, measured and pointed.

lines.text: 哥，钱会计的车刚上东三环，往北跑了。黑色奔驰，车牌尾号零零一。
lines.instruct: 电话里，语速快，盯梢的紧张。
lines.textEn: Qian's just hit the East 3rd Ring heading north. Black Mercedes, plate ending zero-zero-one.
lines.instructEn: On the phone, fast, tense from tailing him.

lines.text: 后头跟着一辆SUV。他要上机场高速——过了四元桥，就追不上了。
lines.textEn: There's an SUV behind him. He's going for the airport road - past Siyuan Bridge, he's gone.

lines.text: SUV 在别你！甩开它，盯住奔驰！
lines.textEn: The SUV's trying to push you off! Shake it, stay on the Mercedes!

lines.text: 哥！没事吧？快找辆车，接着追！
lines.textEn: Are you OK?! Grab a car and keep after him!

lines.text: 后面又上来两辆，豹哥急了。
lines.textEn: Two more coming up behind - Panther's getting desperate.

lines.text: 他们掉头了。哥，回大刘那儿。
lines.textEn: They're turning back. Get to Big Liu's.
He's watching his mirror... ease off.

lines.text: 老周，交通队的？借一步说话。
lines.textEn: Zhou. Traffic police, right? A word.

lines.text: 账本上有你的名字。每一笔，记得清清楚楚。
lines.textEn: Your name's in the ledger. Every payment, written down nice and neat.

lines.text: 礼拜五晚上，京哈高速，白鹿收费站。
lines.textEn: Friday night. The Jingha expressway, Bailu toll gate.

lines.text: 周队，豹哥让我问问，账本的事儿，您那儿怎么说？
lines.instruct: 皮笑肉不笑，带点儿威胁。
lines.textEn: Officer Zhou. The boss wants to know - what are you doing about the ledger?
lines.instructEn: A thin smile, a hint of threat.

lines.text: 豹哥说了，礼拜五那批货走完，就收手。
lines.textEn: The boss says after Friday's load, that's it. We're done.

lines.text: 周队……后头那辆车，跟您一路了吧？
lines.textEn: Officer Zhou... that car back there. Been with you all the way, hasn't it?

lines.text: 账本上那个老周，我查清楚了。东边交通队的，管事故车和拖车场。
lines.instruct: 慢条斯理，压低声音交底。
lines.textEn: That Zhou in the ledger - I looked into him. Traffic police, out east. Runs the accident cars and the tow yard.

lines.text: 穿着制服的黑豹。小雨说，他今晚一下班，就去见豹哥的人。
lines.textEn: A Panther in uniform. Xiaoyu says he's meeting Panther's people tonight, straight after his shift.

lines.text: 别开我那辆，他认得。路边那辆灰的，钥匙在上头。
lines.textEn: Don't take my car, he knows it. The grey one by the kerb - keys are in it.
lines.instructEn: An instruction, a nod towards the kerb.

lines.text: 跟着他。别跟丢了，也别让他瞧见你。
lines.textEn: Follow him. Don't lose him, and don't let him see you.

lines.instruct: 电话里，慢悠悠，听不出喜怒。
lines.instructEn: On the phone, unhurried, giving nothing away.

lines.text: 豹哥这是要跑……我去叫上大刘。这回，咱们把路堵上。
lines.instruct: 电话里，沉吟片刻，然后果断。
lines.textEn: Panther's making a run for it... I'll get Big Liu. This time we block the road.
lines.instructEn: On the phone, a pause, then decisive.

lines.text: 哥，他出来了。银色轿车，车牌尾号七三一。
lines.instruct: 电话里，压低声音，盯梢的紧张。
lines.textEn: He's out. Silver saloon, plate ending seven-three-one.
lines.instructEn: On the phone, hushed, tense from tailing him.

lines.text: 别跟太近。他是交警，看后视镜比谁都勤。
lines.textEn: Don't sit on his tail. He's traffic police - he checks his mirrors more than anyone.
lines.instructEn: On the phone, a serious warning.

lines.textEn: He's turning off - don't lose him!

lines.text: 这不是回家的路……他往广渠门去了。
lines.textEn: This isn't the way home... he's heading for Guangqumen.

lines.text: 他停车了。找个地方停下，离远点儿。
lines.textEn: He's pulled over. Find somewhere to stop and keep your distance.

lines.text: 哥，老周跑了，还报了警！别让他跑回支队！
lines.textEn: Zhou's running - and he called the police! Stop him before he gets back to his station!

lines.text: 警车往你那儿去了！快走！
lines.textEn: Police coming your way! Go, now!
lines.instructEn: On the phone, tense and hurrying.

lines.text: 我怎么说？你们自己把账本弄丢了，还有脸问我？
lines.textEn: Me? You lot lose your own ledger and come asking me?

lines.text: 我把拖车场借给你们换牌子，事故车进来，干净车出去——出了事，我第一个进去。
lines.textEn: I lend you my yard to swap plates - a wreck goes in, a clean car comes out. If this blows up, I'm the first one inside.
...After Friday, don't ever call me again.

lines.text: 喂，110吗？广渠门这儿有人袭警！
lines.instruct: 对着电话，慌张又装腔作势。
lines.textEn: Hello, police? Someone's attacking an officer at Guangqumen!
lines.instructEn: Into the phone, flustered but putting on airs.

lines.text: 别、别动手！我就是个看拖车场的！
lines.textEn: Don't - don't hit me! I just run the tow yard!

lines.text: 礼拜五……礼拜五晚上，豹哥最后一车货走京哈高速，过白鹿收费站出京。货一走，他就收手。
lines.textEn: Friday... Friday night Panther's sending one last load out on the Jingha expressway, through the Bailu toll gate. After that he's out.

lines.text: 陈野！三年前那场车祸没要了你的命，今天我亲手送你走！
lines.instruct: 对讲机里，暴怒，咬牙切齿。
lines.textEn: Chen Ye! Three years ago that crash didn't finish you. Tonight I'll do it myself.
lines.instructEn: On the radio, furious, spitting the words.

lines.text: 老K，你一个开茶摊的，也来蹚这浑水？
lines.textEn: Old K. A man who runs a tea stall, sticking his nose in this?

lines.text: 陈野，三年前你就该躺在那儿，别起来。
lines.textEn: Chen Ye. Three years ago you should have stayed down.

lines.instructEn: A beat of silence, then a roar.

lines.textEn: Can't ram it - then I jump on.
lines.instructEn: Flat, as if it were nothing.

lines.textEn: Steel... it'll have to be the jump.
lines.instructEn: After a hit, muttering through his teeth.

lines.text: 三年前那笔账，今晚一起算。
lines.textEn: Three years ago. We settle that tonight too.
lines.instructEn: Low, holding his anger, word by word.

lines.textEn: Old K. The debt - are we square?

lines.text: 三辆车。前头一辆探路的，中间是货车——车厢包了铁皮，撞不停。
lines.instruct: 粗声粗气，掰着手指头数。
lines.textEn: Three cars. A scout up front, the truck in the middle - they've plated the box with steel, you won't ram it to a stop.

lines.text: 后头那辆黑色大轿车，豹哥自己坐着。
lines.textEn: The big black saloon at the back - that's Panther himself.
lines.instructEn: Lowering his voice, through his teeth.

lines.text: 开这辆。从黑豹手里扣下的跑车，氮气给你灌满了。
lines.textEn: Take this one. A sports car we took off Panther's people - I filled the nitro.
lines.instructEn: Patting the roof, a little proud.

lines.text: 礼拜五了。豹哥的车队，十点从东郊出发，走京哈高速出京。
lines.instruct: 夜里，压低声音，沉稳交底。
lines.textEn: It's Friday. Panther's convoy leaves the east side at ten and takes the Jingha expressway out of Beijing.
lines.instructEn: At night, low and steady, laying it out.

lines.text: 白鹿收费站那头，我打了招呼。我和大刘在那儿等你。货车你拿下，给我们开过来。
lines.textEn: I've had a word at the Bailu toll gate. Big Liu and I will be waiting there. You take the truck and bring it to us.

lines.text: 看见你了。开过来，路已经堵上了。
lines.textEn: We can see you. Bring it in - the road's blocked.
lines.instructEn: On the phone, steady and reassuring.

lines.text: 这条路，是我们这些人跑了一辈子跑出来的。你想把它变成你的——不行。
lines.textEn: People like us spent our whole lives driving this road. You want to make it yours - no.
The road out east is clean.
Square? Don't be daft. Come for tea tomorrow.

lines.text: 豹哥，账本、老周、这一车货——够你在里头说好些年了。
lines.textEn: Panther. The ledger, Zhou, and a truck full of goods - you'll have plenty to talk about inside.

lines.text: 陈野，这回算你帮了忙。下回……别让我在高速上追你。
lines.textEn: Chen Ye, you did us a favour this time. Next time... don't make me chase you down an expressway.
lines.instructEn: Half joking, half a real warning.

lines.text: 哥，车队就在你前面，三辆，往东去了。
lines.textEn: Brother, the convoy's right ahead of you. Three cars, heading east.
lines.instructEn: On the phone, tense and excited.

lines.text: 他们发现你了！后头那辆大轿车在减速——小心！
lines.textEn: They've seen you! The big saloon's dropping back - watch it!

lines.text: 哥！你没事吧？找辆车接着追！
lines.textEn: Brother! Are you OK? Grab a car and get after them!
lines.instructEn: On the phone, startled and worried.

lines.text: 离收费站还有三公里，老K和大刘到了！
lines.textEn: Three kilometres to the gate - Old K and Big Liu are there!

lines.text: 我开车那会儿，三环上没人跑得过我。
lines.textEn: In my day nobody beat me on the Third Ring.

lines.text: 变速箱得好好伺候，跟伺候家里人一样。
lines.textEn: Treat a gearbox gently, like family.

lines.text: 三环上我叫小飞龙，没人不知道。
lines.textEn: On the Third Ring they call me Little Dragon.
You're on. Get in your car and keep up!

lines.text: 哟，开出租的也敢来找我？
lines.textEn: A cabbie, come to see me?

lines.text: 三场都输给你，我服了。我这套改装件归你了！
lines.instruct: 不甘心地认输，最后爽快起来。
lines.textEn: Three times... alright, I'm done. My tuning parts are yours!

lines.text: 这北京城啊，钱都在路上跑。
lines.textEn: In this city the money's always on the move.

lines.text: 做事儿要稳，跑得快不如跑得稳。

lines.instruct: 慢悠悠地招呼，带点儿江湖气。

lines.text: 北京站门口的客最多，赶火车的给钱也痛快。
lines.textEn: Most fares are at the station, and people with trains to catch tip well.

lines.text: 开出租就两条：嘴要甜，车要稳。
lines.textEn: Two rules for a cabbie: sweet talk, smooth driving.
Driving a cab now, are you?

lines.text: 这条街上的事儿，没有我不知道的。
lines.textEn: Nothing happens on this street I don't hear about.

lines.instruct: 大方爽快地把东西塞过去。
